profile.reading: This H5 Data Centers facility is located at 1125 Energy Park Drive, Suite 100, St. Paul, Minnesota 55108, in the Minneapolis-St. Paul metro area. The building totals approximately 17,000 square feet, with N+1 UPS power, multiple diesel generators with 48 hour runtime, cold aisle containment, and N+1 CRAC cooling, per the operator own facility page. The facility connects to 6 on net carriers. No MW capacity figure is published for this specific building.
